# Pallas - Vue/Vite Motion Design Website

## Project Overview
This is a Vue.js + Vite frontend website featuring:
- Motion design MPEG-4 logo as background (`flash.mp4`)
- Responsive burger menu navigation
- Mobile-first optimization
- Full black background theme
- Modern component-based architecture

## Development Guidelines
- Use composition API for Vue components
- Implement responsive design with mobile-first approach
- Ensure MPEG-4 video background is optimized for performance
- Use CSS Grid/Flexbox for layouts
- Maintain accessibility standards for navigation
- Follow Vue 3 best practices

## Key Features Implemented
- ✅ MPEG-4 video background with proper fallbacks
- ✅ Hamburger menu with smooth animations
- ✅ Mobile-responsive navigation
- ✅ Black theme with contrasting elements
- ✅ Performance optimizations for video content

## Architecture
- **App.vue**: Main component with video background and navigation
- **BurgerMenu.vue**: Animated hamburger menu component
- **style.css**: Global dark theme and responsive styles
- **Assets**: Contains motion design video (`flash.mp4`)

## Development Commands
- `npm run dev` - Start development server
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm run preview` - Preview production build
